DVCS_xsec module

DVCS cross-section formulas using twist-two Compton form factors.

This module implements the five-fold differential cross-section d sigma / (d xB dt dQ dphi dphi_S) for deeply virtual Compton scattering (DVCS), following the formalism of Guo et al. (2022).

The total cross-section is decomposed into three contributions:

  • BH: Bethe–Heitler (pure QED process)

  • DVCS: pure deeply virtual Compton scattering

  • INT: BH–DVCS interference term

All kinematic scalar coefficient functions are JIT-compiled with Numba.

gumpgpd.DVCS_xsec.A_BH(y: float, xB: float, t: float, Q: float, phi: float)[source]

Kinematical variable for BH cross-section

Defined in the appendix of https://inspirehep.net/literature/1925449
Code converted from the Mathematica master code and numerically checked
Parameters:

  • y (float) – Beam energy lost parameter

  • xB (float) – x_bjorken

  • t (float) – momentum transfer square

  • Q (float) – photon virtuality

  • phi (float) – azimuthal angle

Returns:

kinematic coefficient A for the BH cross-section

Return type:

A_BH (float)

gumpgpd.DVCS_xsec.Asymmetry_DVCS_TOT(y: float, xB: float, t: float, Q: float, phi: float, pol, HCFF: complex, ECFF: complex, HtCFF: complex, EtCFF: complex)[source]

DVCS single/double spin asymmetry.

Defined as the ratio of the polarized total cross-section to the unpolarized one at the same kinematics.

Parameters:

  • y (float) – Beam energy lost parameter

  • xB (float) – x_bjorken

  • t (float) – momentum transfer squared

  • Q (float) – photon virtuality

  • phi (float) – azimuthal angle

  • pol (str) – polarization configuration; see _pol_to_index()

  • HCFF (complex) – Compton form factor H

  • ECFF (complex) – Compton form factor E

  • HtCFF (complex) – Compton form factor ~H

  • EtCFF (complex) – Compton form factor ~E

Returns:

spin asymmetry \(A = d\sigma(\text{pol}) / d\sigma(\text{UU})\)

Return type:

float

gumpgpd.DVCS_xsec.dsigma_DVCS_HERA(y: float, xB: float, t: float, Q: float, pol, HCFF: complex, ECFF: complex, HtCFF: complex, EtCFF: complex)[source]

Virtual-photon–proton cross-section, integrated over \(\phi\).

The leptonic flux factor is divided out relative to the lepton–proton cross-section.
HERA measures the virtual-photon–proton cross-section, integrated over \(\phi\).
Parameters:

  • y (float) – Beam energy lost parameter

  • xB (float) – x_bjorken

  • t (float) – momentum transfer squared

  • Q (float) – photon virtuality

  • pol (str) – polarization configuration; see _pol_to_index()

  • HCFF (complex) – Compton form factor H

  • ECFF (complex) – Compton form factor E

  • HtCFF (complex) – Compton form factor ~H

  • EtCFF (complex) – Compton form factor ~E

Returns:

virtual-photon–proton differential cross-section \(d\sigma/(dt)\)

Return type:

float
